codeReview.summary: Clean, complete implementation of all 8 Factory constants in lib/constants.js. All required constants are present with correct values, types, and naming conventions (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE). Path constants correctly use join(homedir(), ...) for resolution. Barrel re-exports added to shuvquota.js. 10 comprehensive tests verify values, types, path resolution, and key set completeness. No bugs or missing edge cases.

issues.description: Factory constants are exported in a second, separate block from './lib/constants.js' rather than being merged into the existing export on line 261. This creates two export-from statements for the same module. Functionally correct but slightly redundant — could be consolidated into a single export block.
Handoff summary claims '11 tests' but there are exactly 10 test() calls in the describe block, matching the 211-201=10 delta in test counts. Minor handoff inaccuracy, not a code issue.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Skill SKILL.md Step 3 prescribes TDD (write tests first, run them to confirm RED). The transcript shows the worker wrote implementation first (edited lib/constants.js, then barrel re-exports, then tests). The deviation is harmless for pure constants but the skill's TDD mandate was not followed.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton shows Edit on lib/constants.js and shuvquota.js barrel re-exports BEFORE the test Edit on shuvquota.test.js. Skill Step 3 says 'Write Tests First (RED)' and 'Run bun test to confirm the new tests FAIL'.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Two separate export-from blocks referencing './lib/constants.js' in the barrel re-exports section of shuvquota.js. As more providers are added, a convention for whether to consolidate or split barrel re-exports per module could prevent divergent patterns.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: shuvquota.js line 261: existing constants export; line 263-272: separate Factory constants export block from the same module.

summary: Feature factory-constants passes review. All 8 required Factory constants (FACTORY_API_BASE, FACTORY_USAGE_URL, FACTORY_TIMEOUT_MS, FACTORY_MULTI_ACCOUNT_PATH, FACTORY_AUTH_FILE_PATH, FACTORY_AUTH_KEY_PATH, FACTORY_OAUTH_REFRESH_BUFFER_MS, FACTORY_PLAN_TIERS) are correctly defined in lib/constants.js following existing naming conventions and patterns. Barrel re-exports added. 10 tests comprehensively verify values, types, and path resolution. Two non-blocking style observations noted: duplicated export-from source module and minor handoff count inaccuracy.
